pages.phaseBoundary: Phase 2 is where these screens gain real workflows, persistence, and crawler execution.

researchQueue.title: Research Queue
researchQueue.description: This screen reserves the entry point for queued research jobs and manual crawl requests.
checklist: Create crawl requests and prompt presets.
Review queue status before execution logic lands.
Keep the navigation and page contracts stable for Phase 2.
researchQueue.handoffBody: Connect queue submission forms, validation, and Celery job dispatch once the domain model is in place.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: This screen marks the future workspace for source groups, captured pages, and research outputs.
checklist: Reserve the layout for dataset and source grouping.
Keep placeholder cards ready for table and detail view insertion.
Expose the screen in both languages from the first release.
collections.handoffBody: Introduce CRUD endpoints and persistent collection views backed by PostgreSQL.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.description: This screen keeps room for timed runs, recurring crawls, and automation windows.
checklist: Reserve recurrence controls and execution calendar sections.
Prepare the route for future scheduler health and worker capacity data.
Maintain a stable navigation target for tests and onboarding.
schedules.handoffBody: Add schedule models, cron-like definitions, and orchestration hooks for worker execution.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: This screen centralizes environment visibility, localization, and infrastructure preferences.
checklist: Keep stack information discoverable during local setup.
Prepare user-facing sections for environment and profile settings.
Avoid implementing account management before Phase 2.
settings.handoffBody: Wire secure settings forms, connection checks, and role-aware configuration management later.
